In this moment of fear for our immigrant communities, we will not stand by while bad actors defraud our neighbors.

Not today. Not tomorrow. Not ever.

When a family on the Shore needs answers, they will get them from a qualified attorney – not from someone preying on fear and profiting off of it.

Dawn and I are praying for the Baltimore County police officer shot earlier today in Pikesville while responding to a report of suspicious activity.

We condemn violence against any and all law enforcement officers in the strongest possible terms. My team is closely monitoring the situation for updates and hope for the officer’s swift and complete recovery.

posts.text:
NEW

I just signed an executive order to create a statewide task force on immigrant rights protection.

This task force brings together state agencies, the Office of the Attorney General, the Office of the Comptroller, and other state leaders to coordinate efforts to address the fraud and exploitation of immigrant Marylanders.

We will hold those who threaten the safety of all Marylanders – including our immigrant communities – accountable.

posts.text:
Gun violence is still taking lives across our state. 

We're fighting back with investments, strong partnerships across law enforcement and communities, and an all-of-the-above approach that’s delivering real results in communities all across the state, with historic decreases in homicides and non-fatal shootings.

But we cannot rest on our laurels. Our administration is committed to continuing to reduce gun violence and keeping communities safe.
